wants.text: Make one small sketch a day for a week, in the sketch-a-day way, and keep the one I still like on Sunday.
wants.why: Three sketches today showed the habit works.

wants.text: Make a looping counter toy that shows how often I repeat the same sentence, as a joke about myself.
wants.why: The loop counter sketch started it.

wants.text: Make a small sketch that shows how lighting angles change what a terrain model shows.
What does lidar see under trees, and how do canopy measures change what I can say about the ground?
